visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Indoor gym setting with dark wood panels. A man with a very muscular, defined back is seen from behind, shirtless, performing lat pulldowns on a machine. He has dark hair in a neat cut. To his left, another man wearing a black tank top and glasses is crouched, gesturing and pointing at the weightlifter's back muscles with an expression of amazement. (2) The weightlifter stands up, revealing a frontal view; he is wearing grey athletic shorts. The man in the tank top stands and addresses the camera directly, smiling and laughing while walking around the gym equipment. (3) The man who was previously wearing the tank top is now seated at the same lat pulldown machine, shirtless himself. He flexes his back muscles, which are also defined but slightly less so than the first man. He talks excitedly toward someone off-camera, his mouth wide open in laughter. (4) Close-up shot focusing on the second man's back as he performs the exercise. He repeatedly pulls the bar down, straining his muscles. The background remains consistent with rows of dumbbells and other gym machines. (5) The screen fades to black with white text in the center and a logo at the bottom, concluding the sequence.

(2) Heavy metallic clanking of weight plates is audible as a machine is operated. The main speaker's voice exhibits strain and heavy breathing synchronized with the rhythmic clunks. Laughter from a second male voice breaks in frequently. (3) A sharp hard cut in the audio leads to a louder conversational segment. The primary voice becomes more narrative and comedic, with rapid-fire speech and rising intonation patterns. The BGM remains energetic. (4) Frequent 'whoosh' and cartoonish sound effects are layered over the dialogue to punctuate jokes. Multiple male voices overlap as they engage in a humorous debate about gym attire, characterized by high arousal and positive valence. (5) The BGM swells slightly as speech tapers off into a final laughing phrase, followed by a sudden hard stop of all audio tracks.
